recent_posts.title: Minecraft 26.2 snapshot 6 adds magma sulfur cubes and redesigned sulfur springs
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft snapshot 26.2 Snapshot 6 for the Chaos Cubed Drop introduces magma sulfur cubes that damage entities on contact, a new slow bouncy archetype for stone/concrete/brick/ore blocks, and redesigned sulfur springs modeled after real-world national parks. Sulfur caves now generate less under oceans and mountains. Numerous bug fixes cover TNT sulfur cubes (fire aspect ignition, mob_griefing rule compliance, game rule interactions), arrow and mace interactions, dispenser behavior, and visual glitches. Geysers no longer push creative-mode players and now emit vibrations. Sulfur spikes can be sold by wandering traders. Three new languages (Gallo, Uzbek, Võro) are added along with stability and crash fixes.

recent_posts.title: TNT Sulfur Cubes & Geysers! What's New in Minecraft 26.2 Snapshot 5?
Minecraft 26.2 snapshot 4 changes to sulfur caves and bug fixes
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft 26.2 Snapshot 4 introduces several changes including sulfur cube texture updates around the eyes, new sounds for bucket interactions with sulfur cubes, and sulfur cave terrain adjustments with granite and tuff dispersed among sulfur and cinnabar blocks. Sulfur spike formations are now shorter (1-4 blocks vs 3-6). Gameplay fixes include lava buckets properly emptying in flowing water, wet sponges no longer duplicating in the Nether, and piglins/hoglins/sulfur cubes spawning correctly on peaceful difficulty. Visual fixes address VSync on Mac, glowing effect on some GPUs, and fishing rod scroll glitches. Two new languages (Swiss French and Chuvash) are added, and the High Contrast resource pack compatibility issue is resolved.

recent_posts.title: Minecraft 26.2 snapshot 3 adds sulfur spikes and bug fixes
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft snapshot 3 for the Chaos Cubed drop introduces sulfur spikes, a new block that generates naturally in sulfur caves, forming stalactites and stalagmites similar to dripstone. They can be crafted into sulfur blocks in a 2x2 pattern. The update also includes texture tweaks for polished sulfur, sulfur bricks, chiseled sulfur, cinnabar variants, and several bug fixes for sulfur cubes, magma cubes, frogs, axolotls, and visual glitches like z-fighting slime bottoms and flowing liquid faces.

recent_posts.title: Sulfur Cubes, Sulfur Caves, Sulfur Blocks! What's New in Minecraft 26.2 Snapshots 1 & 2
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft's upcoming 26.2 update (Chaos Cubed) introduces two new snapshots featuring the Sulfur Cube mob, a passive creature that absorbs blocks and changes its physics behavior based on nine archetypes (bouncy, sticky, sliding, etc.). New block sets include sulfur and cinnabar with polished, brick, and chiseled variants, plus potent sulfur that generates nauseating gas clouds in water. A new underground biome, sulfur caves, generates with sulfur and cinnabar bands, sulfur pools, turquoise water, and spawns cave spiders alongside sulfur cubes. The update also marks the first Minecraft version to support the Vulkan graphics API alongside OpenGL, with a new Graphics API option in settings. Additional fixes address dolphin drowning, dragon death animation, spectator mode teleport, and mob behavior bugs.

recent_posts.title: Exploits and Checkboxes - What's New in Minecraft 26.1.2?
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft 26.1.2 is a hotfix release addressing an undisclosed security exploit and fixing checkbox text display issues in the user interface. It is part of the Tiny Takeover drop update cycle.

recent_posts.title: Tiny Hotfix-over - What's New in Minecraft 26.1.1?
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft 26.1.1 is a minor hotfix release addressing a single user interface bug related to the player reporting functionality. No new features are included; it targets the Tiny Takeover drop. The next major content update will arrive with the first snapshot for version 26.2.

recent_posts.title: Tiny Hotfix-over - News in Minecraft 26.1.1 Release Candidate 1
Minecraft 26.1 Tiny Takeover full changelog overview
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft Java Edition 26.1 (Tiny Takeover) introduces updated models, sounds, and hitboxes for nearly all baby mobs in the game, including farm animals, hostile mobs, aquatic creatures, and nether mobs. New craftable items include nametags (metal nugget + paper) and golden dandelions (dandelion + gold nuggets), which can pause or resume baby mob aging. Stone and deepslate can now be cut into cobbled forms on a stonecutter. Note blocks placed on copper blocks produce trumpet sounds that vary by oxidation level. Villager trade logic is now deterministic per seed, master librarians no longer sell nametags, and wandering traders can now spawn in snowy biomes. Performance improvements include 4GB default RAM allocation and a switch to the ZGC garbage collector, plus an upgrade to Java 25. UI changes include a new world options screen in the pause menu and an updated chat screen.

recent_posts.title: News in Minecraft 26.1 Release Candidate 3 - Littering Dragon Fix
recent_posts.summary: Minecraft Java Edition 26.1 Release Candidate 3 has been released, fixing two bugs: the ender dragon incorrectly dropping XP before reaching the portal on death, and a crash. Previous release candidates addressed no changes (RC1) and a Mac OS input bug (RC2). The full Tiny Takeover update releases the following day.
